name: fintrack
description: Personal finance transaction categorizer & dashboard (React + Vite client, Express + TypeScript server).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
